```python
def _neighbor_mask(points, eps_num, eps_den):
    size, length = points.shape
    mask = np.zeros((size, size), dtype=np.uint8)
    if size == 0: return mask
    # transform: shift values above the padding token so that |T(a)-T(b)| equals
    # the contract coordinate distance (|a-b| + 1000 across the padding gap).
    T = points.astype(np.int32)
    T += np.where(T > PAD, 1000, 0)
    Tf = T.astype(np.float64)
    rowsq = np.einsum('ij,ij->i', Tf, Tf)
    target = float(eps_num)/float(eps_den); target_sq = target*target
    tol = 1e-12*max(target_sq,1.0)
    A = np.zeros((size,size), dtype=np.int8)
    for k in range(length):
        v = T[:,k]
        A += (v[:,None] == v[None,:])
    # squared distances
    chunk = max(1, min(size, (1<<23)//max(1,size*8)))
    for a in range(0,size,chunk):
        b = min(size,a+chunk)
        dot = Tf[a:b] @ Tf.T
        sq = rowsq[a:b,None] + rowsq[None,:] - 2.0*dot
        np.maximum(sq, 0.0, out=sq)
        scaled = (sq/length)*POW36_SQ[A[a:b]]
        close = np.abs(scaled-target_sq) <= tol
        block = np.where(close, 0, scaled <= target_sq).astype(np.uint8)
        if close.any(): ... exact recheck ...
        mask[a:b,:] = block
```
